Hi — I'm Maya, Head of Growth at GreenSprint. I've written up a rough initiative brief for our upcoming subscription box launch (you'll find it in the projects/vertical-farms/ folder). We have a strategy offsite next week and I need a thorough document that analyzes all the ways this initiative could go wrong.

Specifically, I need someone to think through this from a failure perspective — not just list risks, but really structure it so the team can see what's fatal vs. what's merely damaging vs. what's just annoying, with concrete actions to avoid each failure, plus a clear set of behavioral rules the team should commit to (both things to never do AND things to always do).

Please produce this as a file called `failure_analysis.md`. It should be detailed enough to stand alone as a strategy document at our offsite.
